conflict: none — did not build, stage, or assemble
choice_reason: B lets the 2-minute evaluator see the actual decision material without interaction: the qualified 31→9 proof is a hero stat card, the migration objection is the first section with a concrete 3-step import answer and an honest no-duration caveat, and a labeled example handoff shows exactly what the product produces. A presents the same facts honestly but hides the Brightline case detail and the CSV import answer behind collapsed accordions and renders the handoff fields as empty label chips, so the core evidence requires clicks the time budget penalizes. B also has the stronger verified states (distinct empty/format/personal-email validation messages, focused success state, reduced-motion honored in CSS and JS). B's one fact-discipline slip (an unsupported definition of 'handoff omission') is outweighed by its clearer enablement of the stated job.
suspected_unblinding: Labels themselves gave nothing away, but B's source/ retains process artifacts — a self-captured evidence/ folder (relaynotes-pslc-01..07) and step-labeled comments like 'E8: trial-form validation error' — suggesting a checklist- or workflow-driven treatment; A's source has no such artifacts. I do not know which team is which.

unsupported_claims.label: B
unsupported_claims.claim: Expanded Brightline card defines a 'handoff omission' ('a gap the next shift found: a missing owner, an undocumented decision, or a next step nobody wrote down') and asserts Brightline counted by that definition; the supplied facts give the 31-to-9 numbers but no such definition.

findings.label: A
findings.description: The core proof (Brightline before/after and the approved testimonial) and the migration-objection answer are both hidden behind collapsed accordions by default, so a 2-minute evaluator scanning the page sees only two accordion headers where the decisive evidence should be.
findings.evidence: A/desktop.png shows both accordions collapsed; A/evidence/interaction-02-inspect-brightline-case.png and interaction-03-see-csv-import.png show the content only appears after a click.

findings.label: A
findings.description: 'What a handoff contains' renders the five fields as empty label chips with no example values, adding almost no information for someone evaluating what the product actually outputs.
findings.evidence: A/desktop.png, 'What a handoff contains' section (Owner / Customer impact / Latest decision / Next step / Linked evidence chips with no content).

findings.label: A

findings.label: B

findings.evidence: B/evidence/interaction-02-inspect-brightline-case.png and B/source/index.html ('A handoff omission is a gap the next shift found...').
